svg.title: How democratic organizations become oligarchies
svg.desc: Five-step process: democratic beginnings, organizational growth, leadership specialization, concentration of power, and oligarchy.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An organization starts with broad participation and shared decision-making.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: As membership grows, coordination becomes increasingly difficult.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A smaller group develops expertise, information, and control over resources.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leaders consolidate authority and become increasingly difficult to replace.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A small elite effectively controls the organization, even if democratic procedures remain.
